high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a news article from the Financial Express website. The top of the screen shows the time as 7:11 AM with an airplane mode icon, Wi-Fi signal, and battery indicator. Below that, there is the Financial Express logo with the tagline "Read to Lead." The main headline reads, "What did she say?" and discusses a person named Vemuri who wore a red keffiyeh during her graduation speech at MIT. The keffiyeh symbolizes support for the Palestinian cause, and Vemuri used this platform to strongly criticize Israel's actions in Gaza and MIT's research
